The '''4th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best achievements in [[1946 in film|1946 filmmaking]], were held on February 26, 1947 at the [[Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]].

==Winners==
===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Picture]]=== 
*''[[The Best Years of Our Lives]]'' directed by [[William Wyler]]<ref>"Best Picture" {{cite web|url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |title=Golden Globes  |access-date=2011-06-14 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101124174049/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |archive-date=2010-11-24 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Actor in a Leading Role]]=== 
*[[Gregory Peck]] – ''[[The Yearling (1946 film)|The Yearling]]''<ref>"Best Actor in a Leading Role" {{cite web|url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |title=Golden Globes |access-date=2011-06-14 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101124174049/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |archive-date=2010-11-24 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama|Best Actress in a Leading Role]]=== 
*[[Rosalind Russell]] – ''[[Sister Kenny]]''<ref>"Best Actress in a Leading Role" {{cite web|url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |title=Golden Globes  |access-date=2011-06-14 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101124174049/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |archive-date=2010-11-24 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]=== 
*[[Clifton Webb]] – ''[[The Razor's Edge (1946 film)|The Razor's Edge]]''<ref>"Best Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture" {{cite web|url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |title=Golden Globes  |access-date=2011-06-14 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101124174049/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |archive-date=2010-11-24 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actress – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]=== 
*[[Anne Baxter]] – ''[[The Razor's Edge (1946 film)|The Razor's Edge]]''<ref>"Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture" {{cite web|url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |title=Golden Globes  |access-date=2011-06-14 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101124174049/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |archive-date=2010-11-24 }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Director|Best Director-Motion Picture]]=== 
*[[Frank Capra]] – ''[[It's a Wonderful Life]]''<ref>"Best Director-Motion Picture" {{cite web|url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |title=Golden Globes  |access-date=2011-06-14 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101124174049/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |archive-date=2010-11-24 }}</ref>

===Best Film Promoting International Understanding===
*''[[The Last Chance (1945 film)|The Last Chance]]'' directed by [[Leopold Lindtberg]]<ref>"Best Film Promoting International Understanding"{{cite web|url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |title=Golden Globes |access-date=2011-06-14 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101124174049/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |archive-date=2010-11-24 }}</ref>

===Special Achievement Award===
*[[Harold Russell]] – ''[[The Best Years of Our Lives]]''<ref>"Special Achievement Award(Special Award)"{{cite web|url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |title=Golden Globes |access-date=2011-06-14 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101124174049/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1946 |archive-date=2010-11-24 }}</ref>
